[[File:X-30_Lancer_blaster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[X-30 "Lancer" target blast pistol]], a type of blaster weapon]]
'''Weapons''' were devices used to damage or [[Death|kill]] living beings, vehicles, structures or terrain. A [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was known as the "weapon of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]," and it came in many different styles.<ref name="CSWE Lightsaber">{{CSWECite|II|254|lightsaber}}</ref> [[Blaster/Legends|Blasters]] were the most commonly used weapons throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], coming in a vast range of styles, sizes, and firepower. They fired beams of intense light energy, and their energy bolts varied in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="CSWE Blasters">{{CSWECite|I|78|blaster weaponry}}</ref>
